implementations: tools/psl_train/graph.py (the same maths inside the model, TensorFlow)
web/src/psl_hands.js (client side: building the model input only)
why: The main licensed PSL dataset (SignSpeak, psl-signspeak-words) has hand landmarks only: no pose, no face. A model that needs pose or face points cannot learn from it, so PSL v3.0 reads the two hands only. Pose and face are still tracked by every client and are used again when a licensed PSL source with them is added (reports/psl_v3.md says which model uses what).

model_input.layout: asl-islr-543-v1 (shared_data/asl_islr_spec.json): frames x 543 x 3, face 468 | left hand 21 | pose 33 | right hand 21, NaN where missing
model_input.aspect_rule: before the input is built, every x is mapped to the training camera's shape: x' = 0.5 + (x - 0.5) * a / aspect_reference and z' = z * a / aspect_reference, where a = image width / image height of the live camera. Face and pose points are left as they are (the model does not read them).
model_input.hand_slots: anatomical (the signer's left hand in the left-hand rows), unmirrored view, as features_v2.canonicalize_frame assigns them

segment.live: the baseline SignSegmenter (asl_islr_spec.json segmentation) cuts each sign; its frames are resampled to 32
segment.training: frames from the first frame with a hand to the last frame with a hand, plus 2 frames on each side (the segmenter's margin), then resampled to 32

features.units: X = x * aspect_reference, Y = y, Z = z * aspect_reference (all in image heights)
features.hand_size: s[t,h] = largest 2D distance from the wrist (point 0) to any point of hand h in frame t
features.sequence_scale: S = mean of s[t,h] over the frames and hands that are present with s > 1e-6; 1 if there are none

per_frame.name: hand_shape
per_frame.rule: per hand (left, then right), per point 0-20: (P - P_wrist) / s[t,h] for X, Y, Z; zeros when the hand is absent or s <= 1e-6. Equal to features v2's hand_shape block.

per_frame.name: wrist_position
per_frame.rule: per hand: ((X_wrist - origin_x) / S, (Y_wrist - origin_y) / S); zeros when absent

per_frame.name: wrist_motion
per_frame.rule: per hand: wrist_position[t] - wrist_position[t-1]; zeros at t = 0 and when the hand is absent in either frame

per_frame.name: hand_size
per_frame.rule: per hand: s[t,h] / S; zero when absent

per_frame.name: hand_hand_distance
per_frame.rule: left point i to right point j for i, j in [0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20]: 2D distance / S; zeros unless both hands are present

per_frame.name: hand_masks
per_frame.rule: 1.0 / 0.0 for left hand, right hand present

output.values: one score per class; softmax(scores) gives calibrated probabilities (the temperature is applied inside the model)
output.classes: listed in the bundle manifest (models/psl/manifest.json), with each sign's tier and hand count
